title: Pacoh language
text: The Pacoh language, known to its speakers as Pacóuh (meaning "people of the mountain"), is a Katuic Mon-Khmer language belonging to the Austroasiatic family, spoken primarily by ethnic Pacoh communities in the central highlands of Vietnam and southern Laos.
